title: Z9.F shift degree — Actual operator degree in the nonresonant domain
milestone_description: Let $n\ge1$ and let nonzero $H\in\mathbb Q[X]$ satisfy $d=\operatorname{natdeg}H\le7n-3$. Then $d+10\le\operatorname{natdeg}D_n(H)$. The exact coefficient is proved nonzero from these original inequalities. No parity or monicity premise is added. The bound matters: $n=1,H=X^5$ lies outside it and has vanishing coefficient of $X^{15}$ although $D_1(X^5)(1)=-1152$.
